summary: Unregister a PerformanceObserver and clear its observer buffer and options list.

tests.name: records cleared
tests.input: const o=new PerformanceObserver(()=>{}); o.observe({type:'mark'}); performance.mark('x'); o.disconnect(); console.log(o.takeRecords().length);

tests.name: can observe again
tests.input: const o=new PerformanceObserver(()=>{}); o.disconnect(); o.observe({type:'mark'}); console.log('ok');
